claims: Shea Ralph is the head coach of the Vanderbilt women's basketball team.
Shea Ralph was named as the sixth head coach in Vanderbilt women's basketball program history on April 13, 2021.
As of March 2026, Shea Ralph has guided the Vanderbilt Commodores to a program-record 29 wins in a single season.
As of March 2026, Shea Ralph has guided the Vanderbilt Commodores to a trip to the Sweet 16.
As of March 2026, Shea Ralph earned SEC Coach of the Year honors.
Vanderbilt Athletics notes that the 2025-26 season marks Shea Ralph's fifth season leading the Vanderbilt Commodores.
Sports Illustrated states that Shea Ralph led the 2025-26 Vanderbilt team to 29 wins, the most in program history.
Vanderbilt Athletics states that Shea Ralph's staff includes Associate Head Coach Tom Garrick
